caption:
Fantastic Mr Fox Spiced Apple Carrot Molasses Cookies ✨ Perfect for Breafast!
Full recipe! You probably have all ingredients already 🍁✨

Apple Carrot Molasses Breakfast Cookies 🍎
These are a healthy, grab-and-go breakfast packed with fiber! 

Ingredients
Dry:
- 3 cups flour (360g)  (I use spelt and einkorn, any flour will work here) 
- 3 tsp cinnamon  
- 1 tsp nutmeg  
- ½ tsp ginger  
- ¼ tsp cloves  
- 1½ tsp baking powder  
- 1 tsp baking soda  
- 1 tsp salt  

Wet:
- 1⅓ cups coconut sugar (270g) or brown sugar  
- ⅓ cup butter or coconut oil 
- 2 large eggs  
- ⅓ cup unsulphured molasses  
- 1 tsp vanilla  

Add-ins:
- 2 cups shredded apples (firm sweet variety like Honeycrisp/Fuji)  
-1 cup shredded carrots 
-1 cup rolled oats 

Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment.  
2. Whisk all dry ingredients in a bowl.  
3. Beat wet ingredients on medium 2–3 min until smooth.  Add apple and carrot and oats. 
4. Mix dry into wet until combined.  
6. Scoop ¼-1/2 cup portions, space 2" apart on sheets.  - top with apple slices (optional) 
7. Bake 12–14 min until edges lightly browned (check at 10 min for softer centers).  
8. Cool on sheet 2–3 min, then transfer to rack.  

Tips
- Best slightly soft in middle — don’t overbake.  
- Store airtight at room temp 3 days or freeze up to 3 months (microwave 20–30 sec to warm).
